Card-like 3D

Image presents as a tilted physical card on hover/focus via restrained rotateX + rotateY + translateZ.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.card-3d img{
  transition: transform 0.5s ease;
}
.hover-effect.card-3d:hover img,
.hover-effect.card-3d:focus-visible img{
  transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-12deg) translateZ(20px) scale(1.05);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hover-effect.card-3d img{
    transition: none;
  }
  .hover-effect.card-3d:hover img,
  .hover-effect.card-3d:focus-visible img{
    transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-12deg) translateZ(20px) scale(1.05);
  }
}

The animates transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-12deg) translateZ(20px) scale(1.05) for a restrained card-like 3D presentation. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
